cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You have such a good eye for storage. Sorting our shed could finally give your tools a proper home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Until you dump paint tins everywhere again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You could assign every shelf. I'd follow your labels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Including a shelf you're forbidden to touch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. You could put it at eye level so I see what I'm missing.
